## Loading the data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
tt <- tt_load("2026-07-07")
df <- tt[[1]]
```

## Visualization
```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Caption"
#| label: fig-main
ggplot(df, aes(x = wins, y = losses)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Wins vs Losses", caption = "Source: TidyTuesday | 2026-07-07")
```
